def find_Parity(x):
    """Write a python function to find the parity of a given number.

    The parity is even when the binary representation of the number
    contains an even number of set (1) bits, and odd otherwise.
    """
    labels = ("Even Parity", "Odd Parity")
    set_bit_count = bin(abs(x)).count("1")
    # An even set-bit count selects the first label and an odd count
    # selects the second, via the remainder modulo the label count.
    return labels[set_bit_count % len(labels)]
